ody.text: Turg is a massive anurid captured and psychically grafted to Laquatus, which makes him more intelligent, and he eats a Krosan dragonette whose call draws a full-grown dragon to devastate Cabal City.
He fights Seton and Kamahl while Laquatus pursues Kirtar across the northern plains, wrestling Seton in Krosa until his vomited acid nearly blinds him.
At the Order's citadel Turg takes the Mirari from Kirtar but mistakenly hands it to Satas, and Laquatus makes himself central to Aboshan's court and uses Turg to arrest and frame his enemies.
When Aboshan finds the Mirari and prepares to flood Otaria, Laquatus and Turg fight the guards, and Turg is torn apart by a giant squid but kills it too, leaving eggs that yield a tadpole named Uurg.
